reference.source: package/dist/antd.min.js; runtime CSS-in-JS only; frame inherits the same global design-token typography/color as the native provider
reference.operation: capture main Skeleton semantic/config inheritance, normalized callback defaults, nested props, themes, prefixes and ready rendering
reference.nativeBoundary: Main Skeleton retains the existing native host, group/status/locale, flex/responsive guards, title div, width/row normalization and loading=true for explicit undefined. Legacy local class/style stay on the host; new root slot/context style target the placeholder. CSS classes and declared slot effects are compared; default UA heading and table/flex geometry are separate native boundaries. Private hashes/markers and native-only ARIA are excluded.
